" alt="Tête de Pipo"><span>Profil</span><i class="dot" aria-label="Profil à compléter"></i></a><a class="brand" href="#accueil">Nutri<span>Chef</span><small>LE BONHEUR DE BIEN MANGER</small></a><nav aria-label="Navigation principale"><a href="#accueil">Accueil</a><a href="#calendrier">Mon calendrier</a><a href="#courses">Ma liste de courses</a><a href="#restes">Chef, il m’en reste !</a></nav></header><main id="app"></main><footer>NutriChef · Cuisiner simplement, à votre rythme.<br><small>Vos informations sont enregistrées sur cet appareil. <a href="#donnees">Gérer mes données</a></small></footer><div id="toast" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div><dialog id="recipe-modal"><button class="close" aria-label="Fermer">×</button><div id="recipe-body"></div></dialog><script>(async()=>{
const exclusions=['Gluten','Lactose','Fruits à coque','Arachides','Œufs','Soja','Porc','Bœuf','Poisson','Fruits de mer'];
function nutrition(p){const bmi=p.weight/(p.height/100)**2;const bmr=10*p.weight+6.25*p.height-5*p.age+(p.sex==='homme'?5:-161);const tdee=bmr*Number(p.activity);const restricted=p.special||bmi<18.5;return{bmi,bmr:Math.round(bmr),tdee:Math.round(tdee),target:restricted?null:Math.round(tdee*(p.goal==='perdre'?.9:p.goal==='prendre'?1.1:1)),category:bmi<18.5?'Insuffisance pondérale':bmi<25?'Corpulence de référence':bmi<30?'Surpoids':'Obésité'};}
const profileLabel=value=>String(value||'').normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').toLowerCase().trim();function compatible(r,p){if(!p)return true;const diet=profileLabel(p.diet),recipeDiets=(Array.isArray(r.diets)?r.diets:[]).map(profileLabel).filter(Boolean),recipeExclusions=(Array.isArray(r.exclusions)?r.exclusions:[]).map(profileLabel),profileExclusions=new Set((p.exclusions||[]).map(profileLabel).filter(Boolean)),dietOk=!diet||!recipeDiets.length||recipeDiets.includes(diet);return dietOk&&!recipeExclusions.some(item=>profileExclusions.has(item));}
function validateRecipe(r){return r&&typeof r.id==='string'&&typeof r.title==='string'&&Number.isFinite(r.kcal)&&r.kcal>0&&Array.isArray(r.diets)&&Array.isArray(r.exclusions)&&Array.isArray(r.tags)&&Array.isArray(r.meals)&&Array.isArray(r.steps)&&r.steps.every(x=>typeof x==='string')&&Array.isArray(r.ingredients)&&r.ingredients.every(i=>typeof i.name==='string'&&typeof i.unit==='string'&&Number.isFinite(i.qty)&&i.qty>0);}
function addIngredients(list,r,portions=1){for(const i of r.ingredients){const found=list.find(x=>x.name.toLocaleLowerCase('fr')===i.name.toLocaleLowerCase('fr')&&x.unit===i.unit&&!x.done);if(found)found.qty=Math.round((found.qty+i.qty*portions)*100)/100;else list.push({...i,qty:Math.round(i.qty*portions*100)/100,done:false,id:crypto.randomUUID()});}return list;}
function buildMenu(recipes,p,dates){const n=nutrition(p);if(!n.target)throw Error('Un objectif calorique personnalisé nécessite un avis professionnel pour ce profil.');const slots=[['matin',.25],['midi',.35],['soir',.30],['collation',.10]];const pool=recipes.filter(r=>compatible(r,p));const result={};for(const [index,date]of dates.entries()){result[date]={};for(const [slot,fraction]of slots){const eligible=pool.filter(r=>r.meals.includes(slot)&&n.target*fraction/r.kcal>=.5&&n.target*fraction/r.kcal<=2);if(!eligible.length)throw Error('Pas assez de recettes compatibles pour '+slot+'. Aucun menu n’a été modifié.');const r=eligible[index%eligible.length];result[date][slot]={id:r.id,portions:Math.round(n.target*fraction/r.kcal*100)/100};}}return result;}
function isoDate(d=new Date()){return new Date(d.getTime()-d.getTimezoneOffset()*60000).toISOString().slice(0,10);}

const FOODCLOUD_URL='https://naregjbyatnoazyyfwmj.supabase.co';
const FOODCLOUD_ANON_KEY='eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJzdXBhYmFzZSIsInJlZiI6Im5hcmVnamJ5YXRub2F6eXlmd21qIiwicm9sZSI6ImFub24iLCJpYXQiOjE3OTAxODMyMjAsImV4cCI6MjEwNTc1OTIyMH0.3wdp1l-61dSaFyVKDqKr9sM0SlUZT-y6wmDJ0Io9JhI';
const foodCloudDiets=['Omnivore','Végétarien','Végétalien','Pescatarien'];
const foodCloudMeals={breakfast:'matin',lunch:'midi',dinner:'soir',snack:'collation'};
const foodCloudRoutePrefix='__nutrichef:';
const foodCloudRoutes={personnalisees:'personnalisee',panier:'panier_bleu',chef:'chef'};
const foodCloudRecipeRoutes=values=>foodCloudList(values).filter(value=>value.indexOf(foodCloudRoutePrefix)===0).map(value=>value.slice(foodCloudRoutePrefix.length));
const foodCloudVisibleDiets=values=>foodCloudList(values).filter(value=>value.indexOf(foodCloudRoutePrefix)!==0);
const isForFoodCloudRoute=(recipe,route)=>{const routes=recipe.routes||[];return routes.length?routes.includes(foodCloudRoutes[route]):route!=='panier';};
const foodCloudList=value=>Array.isArray(value)?value.filter(item=>typeof item==='string').map(item=>item.trim()).filter(Boolean):typeof value==='string'?value.split(',').map(item=>item.trim()).filter(Boolean):[];
function mapFoodCloudRecipe(raw){const ingredients=Array.isArray(raw.ingredients)?raw.ingredients.map(item=>{const quantity=Number(item?.amount??item?.qty??1);return{name:String(item?.name||'').trim(),qty:Number.isFinite(quantity)&&quantity>0?quantity:1,unit:String(item?.unit||'pièce').trim()||'pièce'};}).filter(item=>item.name):[],rawDiets=foodCloudList(raw.diets),diets=foodCloudVisibleDiets(rawDiets),routes=foodCloudRecipeRoutes(rawDiets),exclusions=foodCloudList(raw.allergens),cuisine=String(raw.cuisine||'').toLocaleLowerCase('fr'),steps=String(raw.description||'').split(/\n+/).map(step=>step.trim()).filter(Boolean),minutes=(Number(raw.prep_time)||0)+(Number(raw.cook_time)||0)||25;return{id:String(raw.id),title:String(raw.name||'').trim(),kcal:Number(raw.calories),ingredients,steps:steps.length?steps:['Préparation à compléter dans FoodCloud.'],diets:diets.length?diets:foodCloudDiets,exclusions,tags:cuisine.includes('méditerr')||cuisine.includes('mediterr')?['mediterraneen']:[],routes,meals:[foodCloudMeals[raw.meal_type]||'midi'],minutes};}
async function getRecipes(){const params=new URLSearchParams({select:'id,name,description,meal_type,cuisine,calories,prep_time,cook_time,ingredients,diets,allergens,status',status:'eq.active',order:'created_at.desc'}),response=await fetch(FOODCLOUD_URL+'/rest/v1/recipes?'+params,{cache:'no-store',headers:{apikey:FOODCLOUD_ANON_KEY,Authorization:'Bearer '+FOODCLOUD_ANON_KEY}});if(!response.ok)throw Error('Impossible d’actualiser le catalogue pour le moment.');const data=await response.json();if(!Array.isArray(data))throw Error('Le catalogue a renvoyé un format inattendu.');return{recipes:data.map(mapFoodCloudRecipe).filter(validateRecipe),demo:false};}
// Assemblage culinaire borné : uniquement des ingrédients connus et des étapes prévues.
function inventRecipe(tokens,profile){const vegetables=[['courgette',200,34],['tomate',180,32],['carotte',150,62],['poivron',150,45],['champignon',150,33],['brocoli',180,61]];const bases=[['riz',70,250,[]],['quinoa',70,258,[]],['pâtes',80,280,['Gluten']],['lentilles',80,280,[]]];const normalize=s=>s.normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').toLowerCase();const found=name=>tokens.some(t=>normalize(t).split(/[^a-z]+/).some(word=>word===normalize(name)||word===normalize(name)+'s'));const veg=vegetables.filter(v=>found(v[0])),base=bases.find(v=>found(v[0]));if(!veg.length||!base)return null;const chosen=veg.slice(0,3);const r={id:'pipo-'+Date.now(),title:'Poêlée de '+chosen.map(v=>v[0]).join(' & ')+' au '+base[0],kcal:base[2]+chosen.reduce((n,v)=>n+v[2],0)+90,minutes:30,diets:['Omnivore','Végétarien','Végétalien','Pescatarien'],exclusions:base[3],tags:[],meals:['midi','soir'],ingredients:[{name:base[0]+' (poids sec)',qty:base[1],unit:'g'},...chosen.map(v=>({name:v[0],qty:v[1],unit:'g'})),{name:'Huile d’olive',qty:10,unit:'g'}],steps:['Utiliser des ingrédients encore consommables. Les quantités de féculents indiquées sont pesées sèches.','Cuire '+base[0]+' dans l’eau en suivant la durée indiquée sur le paquet.','Laver et couper les légumes en petits morceaux. Faire revenir dans l’huile à feu moyen, puis ajouter un peu d’eau et couvrir. Cuire 15 à 20 minutes, jusqu’à tendreté.','Mélanger avec '+base[0]+' cuit et servir chaud.'],generated:true};return compatible(r,profile)?r:null;}

const $=s=>document.querySelector(s),esc=s=>String(s??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
let state={profile:null,weights:[],menus:{},shopping:[]},storageError=false;
try{const s=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('nutrichef-v3'));if(s&&Array.isArray(s.weights)&&Array.isArray(s.shopping)&&s.menus)state=s;}catch{storageError=true;}
let catalogue=[],demo=true,loadError='',step=0,draft={},editing=false,week=0,filter='',selectedMeal='midi',modalRecipe=null,calendarDay='';
const mealNames={matin:'Petit-déjeuner',midi:'Déjeuner',soir:'Dîner',collation:'Collation'},fractions={matin:.25,midi:.35,soir:.3,collation:.1};
const save=()=>{try{localStorage.setItem('nutrichef-v3',JSON.stringify(state));return true;}catch{toast('Enregistrement impossible : vérifiez le stockage du navigateur.');return false;}};
let toastTimer;function toast(s){$('#toast').textContent=s;$('#toast').style.display='block';clearTimeout(toastTimer);toastTimer=setTimeout(()=>$('#toast').style.display='none',5000);}
const fmt=n=>Number(n).toLocaleString('fr-FR',{maximumFractionDigits:1});
function dates(){const d=new Date();d.setDate(d.getDate()-((d.getDay()+6)%7)+week*7);return Array.from({length:7},(_,i)=>{const n=new Date(d);n.setDate(n.getDate()+i);return isoDate(n);});}
const pretty=d=>new Date(d+'T12:00:00').toLocaleDateString('fr-FR',{day:'numeric',month:'short'});
const profileGate=()=>'<div class="card empty"><h2>Commençons par vous connaître.</h2><p>Votre profil permet à Pipo de respecter vos préférences et vos besoins.</p><a class="btn" href="#profil">Créer mon profil</a></div>';
const demoNotice=()=>'';
function recipeCards(rs){return rs.length?'<div class="grid">'+rs.map(r=>`<article class="card recipe"><div class="recipe-art" aria-hidden="true"><svg class="recipe-hat" viewBox="0 0 200 160" focusable="false"><path class="hat-shadow" d="M43 118h114l-8 20H51z"/><path class="hat-main" d="M52 105c-15-4-24-16-24-31 0-19 15-34 34-34 5 0 10 1 14 3 6-15 20-25 38-25 21 0 37 13 42 32 4-2 9-3 14-3 18 0 32 14 32 32 0 15-10 28-24 31v14H52z"/><path class="hat-line" d="M52 119h96"/><path class="hat-line" d="M76 39c8 8 10 18 7 30M111 27c-4 13-2 27 6 39M145 46c-6 8-8 17-6 27"/></svg></div><span class="badge">${r.tags.includes('mediterraneen')?'Cuisine méditerranéenne':'La sélection de Pipo'}</span><h3>${esc(r.title)}</h3><p class="muted">${r.kcal} kcal / portion · ${r.minutes||25} min</p><button class="btn recipe-cta" data-open="${esc(r.id)}">Voir la recette</button></article>`).join('')+'</div>':'<div class="card empty">Aucune recette n’est disponible pour le moment.</div>';}
function home(){const rs=catalogue.filter(r=>compatible(r,state.profile)&&r.meals.includes('midi')).sort(()=>Math.random()-.5).slice(0,3);return`<section class="hero" aria-label="Pipo vous accueille"><img class="hero-art pipo-greeting" src="data:image/png;base64,
